verdict: Search F's null was geometrically invalid and is corrected here. The proper-motion anomaly is transverse to the line of sight, so mark permutation -- which hands a star a vector belonging to a different line of sight -- compares real two-dimensional neighbourhoods against synthetic three-dimensional ones, and random unit vectors have a larger resultant in 3D (0.921 sqrt-k) than in 2D (0.886 sqrt-k). That inflated the null by about 4 per cent and produced the unexplained -3.9 sigma. Rotating each vector about its own line of sight preserves the geometry and destroys only the position-angle correlation a coordinated thrust would create. Against that null the result is z = -0.03: still null, now calibrated. Injection recovers a coherent domain of >=2.0% at 5 sigma.
